definitions.strict_entity_match: Start, end and entity type must all match. Python Unicode character indices; half-open [start,end).
definitions.length_group_assignment: Gold TP/FN by gold length; FP by predicted length. A boundary mismatch may assign its FN/FP to different groups.
definitions.length_group_sentences: Sentences containing at least one gold or predicted entity in this group; can differ between models. Gold support remains fixed.
definitions.small_group_flag: gold<30 or predicted<30 or involved sentences<30; even unflagged finite groups such as 52 or 72 gold require caution.
definitions.component_partition: Remove exact TP; build gold/prediction overlap bipartite graph on FN/FP; connected components give mutually exclusive geometric units.
definitions.split_merge_candidates: 1 gold to multiple predictions / multiple gold to 1 prediction within a component; geometric candidates, not confirmed semantic diagnoses.
definitions.boundary_shapes: Within 1:1 same-type boundary mismatch: predicted span contains gold=overextended; gold contains prediction=undercovered; otherwise shifted.
definitions.side_vs_component_unit: Side categories partition each FN and FP separately; do not add them to components or treat an FN+FP pair as independent causes.
definitions.type_involvement: A component can involve several types; type-involvement counts are nonexclusive and not additive to global events.
definitions.selection: Maximum strict entity micro F1 on fixed internal val, min_delta=0; earliest epoch wins ties.
definitions.endpoint_metrics: Per sentence, unique start character index and inclusive end index=end-1, class-agnostic; exact position-set intersection; gold6601 and predicted strict entity counts as denominators (nonoverlapping BIO). Not overlap-component pairing or auxiliary logits.
definitions.loss_semantics: All four train_loss/val_loss are sample-mean sequence CRF NLL. Fourth total_loss is CRF NLL+0.2*boundary; boundary=(start+end)/2. Per task balanced valid-character BCE: equal positive-mean and negative-mean, single-class batches use that class. Epoch losses sample-count-weight batch means, not global character-balanced BCE.
definitions.csv_format: Lossless scalar export: json_path,value_json. Paths use $/dictionary_key/list_index; value_json is JSON of the scalar, preserving type and precision.

startup_gradient_scale.assessment: Nonzero finite auxiliary gradients reach shared representations and BERT. Ordinary-batch contribution is measurable; longest-batch contribution is weak at untrained initialization. Sequence-mean CRF NLL and balanced character BCE have different scales. Neither lambda nor loss fraction measures gradient share.
startup_gradient_scale.decision: Keep the requested fixed design. No detached/zero/underflowed or dominating auxiliary gradient was found. A weak longest-initialization ratio alone cannot establish that the auxiliary task has no effect throughout training. No lambda adjustment, normalization substitution, or effectiveness claim.
startup_gradient_scale.limitation: Only initial zero-update probes; representative embedding gradients and shared-character gradients, not a full-encoder aggregate or trained-model result. Follow-up audit must inspect component curves and real boundary errors.

limitations: One training seed42 per setting; Bootstrap samples dialogues, not training seeds.
All best checkpoints selected on the same internal val; exploratory interval is conditional on that selection.
No official dev/test prediction or independent external generalization assessment.
Validation NLL crosschecked saved records only, not full-val reinference; sampled inference checks decode consistency.
Error split/merge components are geometric candidates, not confirmed semantic error causes.
Sparse length groups require caution; zero-support F1=0 is a convention, not evidence of failure.
Exp2 versus Exp3 changes both research parameters and is not a causal single-factor comparison.
Baseline interrupted/resumed timing and discarded updates prevent a clean physical speed comparison.

Fourth-vs-third comparison changes auxiliary structure/target only, with version/logging/resource plumbing; initialization/RNG preservation tested. It is not a fourth-vs-second single-variable contrast.

Per-task gradient contribution observed in two real startup probes, not recorded at every formal update; batch losses, total gradient norms, head optimizer states and cross-epoch head changes support actual participation.
Full best-fourth validation reinference reproduced predictions and all component losses/auxiliary metrics; other epochs have prediction-based score recomputation and saved-loss crosschecks.
No auxiliary-head logits were persisted per sentence; all-epoch auxiliary metrics are saved runtime aggregates; best-epoch diagnostics independently reproduced.
CRF endpoint matches are class-agnostic independent position-set intersections, not complete strict entities or semantic pairing.
Training data, fixed split, pretrained weights, resources and full local evidence are not included in the public repository; resource/config references require controlled external inputs.
